question: Which of the following ministries of the Government of India has under it the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Science and Technology**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Council of Industrial Research** (CSIR) was established in **1942 **and has its headquarters in **New Delhi**.
 
• The **CSIR** has a network of** 38 national laboratories** and** 39 outreach** centers spread across the country.
 
• The **Council of Scientific undefined Industrial Research** (CSIR) comes under the **Ministry of Science and Technology**.
 
• **CSIR** is a premier national organization in India and is among the world's l**argest publicly funded organization.**
 
• The** Ministry of Science and Technology** is responsible for promoting the development and application of science and technology in various sectors of the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Ministry of Commerce and Industry** is responsible for **formulating and implementing policies** for the promotion of internal, external trade and commerce in India as well as for the promotion of industrial development in India.
 
• The **Ministry of Earth Sciences **is responsible for **promoting sustainable development** of oceans, atmosphere, and other natural resources and provide weather and climate-related services to various sectors of the economy.
 
• The** Ministry of Education** is responsible for the **formulation of policies, laying down of norms, and standards for education in India**.
